summary.pre_registered_rule_triggered: INCOMPLETE: DWR consistency checks fail, reference solutions uncertain, or experimental controls violated

scientific_qualifications: Three of the four tested benchmark quantities of interest were local displacement patch averages, not global objectives.
Local stress objectives (notch tip, hole stress concentration, re-entrant corner stress intensity) were never evaluated in Phase B or B.1.
Reference grid convergence index (GCI) uncertainties on three benchmarks (0.21% to 1.76%) exceeded the frozen 0.05% threshold and were comparable to or greater than target error levels.
The previously reported 77.3% underestimation frequency is not a clean, independently reference-verified measure of DWR reliability across all problems.
Observed degree of freedom (DOF) and runtime ratios are preserved as diagnostic evidence rather than definitive hypothesis results.
